name: @monkeytype/desktop
description: Offline macOS Apple Silicon port of Monkeytype using Electron
author: Monkeytype contributors

scripts.build:main: tsup src/main.ts src/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --out-dir build --clean
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:main" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main.ts src/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --out-dir build --watch
scripts.package: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64
scripts.pack: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
